title: Opening, previewing and editing
intro: Click a file's name to look inside it without downloading it. A row of buttons sits above the preview.

steps: Click **Word (this computer)** to open a Word file in Word on your computer and make your changes there. Excel and PowerPoint files get a matching button.
Click **Share** to send the file to someone.
Click **Download** to save a copy to your computer.
Click **Details** to see who added it, when it changed and where it is kept.
sections.note: If your company has turned on editing in the browser, the first button is **Edit** instead, and an **Open in ⌄** button beside it offers both ways of opening the file.

sections.heading: What you can preview
text: These files open right inside Depot, without downloading them:
bullets: Pictures, PDFs, videos, audio and saved emails.
Text, Markdown, CSV, JSON and log files, shown with line numbers.
sections.tip: Click the arrows at the sides of the preview, or press the left or right arrow key, to see the previous or next file.
